About New Anmol

Healthcare education grounded in learning, training and professional preparation.

New Anmol Group of Institutions offers programmes in nursing, paramedical sciences and pharmacy, with an educational approach centred on academic development and practical learning.

The institution places emphasis on teaching, training, critical thinking, ethical values, skill development and the holistic growth of students.

Campus & infrastructure

Spaces that support learning by doing.

Lecture spaces, library resources, departmental laboratories, computer facilities and rooms for seminars and academic events support the academic environment.

Learning at New Anmol

Student-centred, independent and practical.

Learning is a conversation, not simply a lecture.

Students are encouraged to develop their own ideas, opinions and critical-thinking abilities; to become independent, self-motivated learners; and to connect theory with hands-on experience.

  • Critical thinking and problem solving
  • Teamwork and goal setting
  • Practical, hands-on learning
  • Research and teaching integration
